violations.why: irq_pebble can preempt main between the two reads of v_drift, because v_fern, v_thorn and v_quarry are all 1 by then. The two reads can see different values.
irq_pebble (higher priority) can preempt irq_crest after it writes v_summit. Pebble overwrites it, so crest reads a value it did not write.
irq_pebble can change v_summit between the two reads in irq_crest.
irq_pebble can overwrite v_fjord between crest's write and its later read.
irq_pebble can overwrite v_fjord between crest's write and its later read.
irq_pebble writes v_kiln[9000] after crest writes it in the loop and before crest reads it at line 151. Crest then reads pebble's value.
